name: Clark County, WA
findings: Clark County has 1,251 nonprofit organizations. 519 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 417 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Clark County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list public events
